# MP Films

> MP Films is a Swiss-Salvadoran film studio based in Basel, Switzerland, run by Miguel Arauz (director and cinematographer, grew up in El Salvador) and Pamina (producer, grew up in Switzerland). Concept: "Swiss precision. Latin soul."

## MP Films Studio (main business)
- Social media video production and brand films for premium businesses in Basel-Stadt, Basel-Landschaft and Bern: clinics, hotels, restaurants, real estate and Swiss product brands.
- Monthly plans: Presence CHF 1,250 (4 Reels, 4 photos, 1 session), Growth CHF 1,850 (6 Reels, 8 photos, 1 session, aerial footage), Dominance CHF 2,700 (8 Reels, 12 photos, 1–2 sessions, aerial footage, basic ads setup).
- Single packages: Reel session CHF 490 (1 Reel up to 45 s, 4 photos, 1 shooting session up to 1.5 h), credited to the first month when continuing with a plan. Short film CHF 1,490 (1 film of 60–90 s, 7 photos, 1 shooting session up to 3 h).
- Licensed drone pilot.
- Details: https://mpfilms.ch/social-media-video/ · German: https://mpfilms.ch/de/social-media-videoproduktion-basel/

## MP Films Weddings
- Film-only wedding videography in Spanish, English and German. Documentary style, aerial footage.
- Focus: couples who bring two cultures together, e.g. Latin American and Swiss families. Weddings in Switzerland and destination weddings in El Salvador, Guatemala and Mexico.
- Packages: Vows CHF 2,200 (up to 5 h), Story CHF 3,600 (up to 10 h), Feature CHF 5,400 (full day). Outside Switzerland plus travel.
- Details: https://mpfilms.ch/weddings/ · Spanish: https://mpfilms.ch/es/bodas/ · German: https://mpfilms.ch/de/hochzeit/
